actions.delete_row.description: Deletes one or more rows from a table
actions.delete_row.props.markdown.descri: Every matching row is deleted, and this cannot be undone.
actions.delete_row.props.search_column.d: The column to match rows on.
actions.delete_row.props.search_value.de: The value that column must equal.
actions.delete_row.props.timezone.descri: Timezone of dates on the server: Z for UTC, or an offset like +02:00.
actions.execute_query.description: Runs a SQL statement on the database and returns its results
actions.execute_query.props.args.descrip: Values for each ? in the query, in order.
actions.execute_query.props.markdown.des: Never type dynamic values into the SQL. Write ? instead and put the values in Arguments to prevent SQL injection.
actions.execute_query.props.query.descri: The SQL to run. Write ? where each value goes.
actions.execute_query.props.timezone.des: Timezone of dates on the server: Z for UTC, or an offset like +02:00.
actions.find_rows.props.args.description: Values for each ? in the condition, in order.
actions.find_rows.props.columns.descript: Leave empty to return every column.
actions.find_rows.props.condition.descri: The SQL after WHERE. Write ? where each value goes.
actions.find_rows.props.markdown.descrip: Never type dynamic values into the SQL. Write ? instead and put the values in Arguments to prevent SQL injection.
actions.find_rows.props.timezone.descrip: Timezone of dates on the server: Z for UTC, or an offset like +02:00.
actions.get_tables.description: Returns a list of tables in the database
actions.insert_row.description: Inserts a new row into a table
actions.insert_row.props.timezone.descri: Timezone of dates on the server: Z for UTC, or an offset like +02:00.
actions.insert_row.props.values.descript: Column names and the values to store in them.
actions.insert_rows.description: Inserts many rows into a table in a single transaction
actions.insert_rows.props.keep_empty_str: Insert empty fields as empty strings instead of the column default.
actions.insert_rows.props.timezone.descr: Timezone of dates on the server: Z for UTC, or an offset like +02:00.
actions.mysql_call_procedure.description: Calls a stored procedure and returns its result sets and OUT parameters.
Values for the IN and INOUT parameters, in order. Leave out OUT parameters.
actions.mysql_call_procedure.props.proce: Procedure name, as returned by List Routines. Use database.procedure for one outside the connection database.
actions.mysql_count_rows.description: Counts the rows of a table that match the filters.
actions.mysql_count_rows.props.filters.d: Conditions combined with AND. Each has a column, an operator (=, !=, <, <=, >, >=, LIKE, NOT LIKE, IN, NOT IN, IS NULL, IS NOT NULL) and a value. For IN / NOT IN pass a JSON list such as ["a", "b"] or comma-separated values; IS NULL / IS NOT NULL take no value.
actions.mysql_count_rows.props.table.des: Table name, as returned by Get Tables. Use database.table to reach a table outside the connection database.
actions.mysql_delete_rows.description: Permanently deletes every row that matches the filters, up to a safety limit.
Conditions combined with AND. Each has a column, an operator (=, !=, <, <=, >, >=, LIKE, NOT LIKE, IN, NOT IN, IS NULL, IS NOT NULL) and a value. For IN / NOT IN pass a JSON list such as ["a", "b"] or comma-separated values; IS NULL / IS NOT NULL take no value. At least one filter is required.
Refuse, changing nothing, if more rows than this would be deleted (1-10000). Defaults to 100.
actions.mysql_delete_rows.props.table.de: Table name, as returned by Get Tables. Use database.table to reach a table outside the connection database.
actions.mysql_describe_table.description: Lists the columns of a table with their types, keys and defaults.
actions.mysql_describe_table.props.datab: Database name, as returned by List Databases. Leave empty to use the connection database.
actions.mysql_describe_table.props.table: Table name, as returned by Get Tables. Use database.table to reach a table outside the connection database.
actions.mysql_explain_query.description: Shows how MySQL would execute a query, without running it.
actions.mysql_explain_query.props.args.d: Values for each ? in the query, in order.
The statement to explain, without the EXPLAIN keyword. Write ? where each value goes.
actions.mysql_find_rows.description: Finds rows in a table using structured filters, sort and paging.
actions.mysql_find_rows.props.columns.de: Columns to return. Leave empty for all columns.
actions.mysql_find_rows.props.filters.de: Conditions combined with AND. Each has a column, an operator (=, !=, <, <=, >, >=, LIKE, NOT LIKE, IN, NOT IN, IS NULL, IS NOT NULL) and a value. For IN / NOT IN pass a JSON list such as ["a", "b"] or comma-separated values; IS NULL / IS NOT NULL take no value.
actions.mysql_find_rows.props.limit.desc: Maximum number of rows to return (1-1000). Defaults to 100.
actions.mysql_find_rows.props.offset.des: Number of rows to skip, for paging. Use nextOffset from the previous call with the same filters and sort.
actions.mysql_find_rows.props.sort.descr: Sort order; each entry has a column and a direction (ASC or DESC). Set a sort when paging so pages are stable.
actions.mysql_find_rows.props.table.desc: Table name, as returned by Get Tables. Use database.table to reach a table outside the connection database.
actions.mysql_get_row_by_key.description: Gets the one row whose key column equals a value.
actions.mysql_get_row_by_key.props.keyCo: A primary-key or unique column, e.g. id.
actions.mysql_get_row_by_key.props.keyVa: The value of the key column, e.g. the insertId returned by Insert Row.
actions.mysql_get_row_by_key.props.table: Table name, as returned by Get Tables. Use database.table to reach a table outside the connection database.
actions.mysql_get_server_info.descriptio: Returns the server version, current database and user, time zone and SQL mode.
actions.mysql_get_view_definition.descri: Returns the CREATE VIEW statement of a view.
View name, as returned by List Views. Use database.view for a view outside the connection database.
actions.mysql_insert_rows.description: Inserts a list of rows into a table in one transaction.
actions.mysql_insert_rows.props.rows.des: A list of objects, one per row, e.g. [{"name": "Ada", "age": 36}]. Column names come from Describe Table.
actions.mysql_insert_rows.props.table.de: Table name, as returned by Get Tables. Use database.table to reach a table outside the connection database.
actions.mysql_list_databases.description: Lists the databases the connection user can see.
actions.mysql_list_databases.props.nameP: Optional SQL LIKE pattern on the name, e.g. %order%. Leave empty to list all.
actions.mysql_list_indexes.description: Lists the indexes of a table and the columns each one covers.
actions.mysql_list_indexes.props.databas: Database name, as returned by List Databases. Leave empty to use the connection database.
actions.mysql_list_indexes.props.table.d: Table name, as returned by Get Tables. Use database.table to reach a table outside the connection database.
actions.mysql_list_processes.description: Lists the connections running on the server and what each is doing.
actions.mysql_list_processes.props.limit: Maximum number of rows to return (1-1000). Defaults to 100.
actions.mysql_list_routines.description: Lists the stored procedures and functions in a database with their parameters.
actions.mysql_list_routines.props.databa: Database name, as returned by List Databases. Leave empty to use the connection database.
actions.mysql_list_routines.props.namePa: Optional SQL LIKE pattern on the name, e.g. %order%. Leave empty to list all.
actions.mysql_list_views.description: Lists the views in a database.
Database name, as returned by List Databases. Leave empty to use the connection database.
actions.mysql_list_views.props.namePatte: Optional SQL LIKE pattern on the name, e.g. %order%. Leave empty to list all.
actions.mysql_run_select_query.descripti: Runs a read-only SQL query and returns up to a limit of rows.
actions.mysql_run_select_query.props.arg: Values for each ? in the query, in order.
actions.mysql_run_select_query.props.lim: Maximum number of rows to return (1-1000). Defaults to 100.
actions.mysql_run_select_query.props.que: One read-only SQL statement. Write ? where each value goes, e.g. SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = ?
actions.mysql_update_rows.description: Updates every row that matches the filters, up to a safety limit.
Conditions combined with AND. Each has a column, an operator (=, !=, <, <=, >, >=, LIKE, NOT LIKE, IN, NOT IN, IS NULL, IS NOT NULL) and a value. For IN / NOT IN pass a JSON list such as ["a", "b"] or comma-separated values; IS NULL / IS NOT NULL take no value. At least one filter is required.
Refuse, changing nothing, if more rows than this would be updated (1-10000). Defaults to 100.
actions.mysql_update_rows.props.table.de: Table name, as returned by Get Tables. Use database.table to reach a table outside the connection database.
actions.mysql_update_rows.props.values.d: Column names mapped to new values, e.g. {"status": "archived"}. Columns left out keep their value.
actions.mysql_upsert_row.description: Inserts a row, or updates the existing row with the same primary or unique key.
actions.mysql_upsert_row.props.table.des: Table name, as returned by Get Tables. Use database.table to reach a table outside the connection database.
actions.mysql_upsert_row.props.updateCol: Columns to overwrite when the row already exists. Leave empty to overwrite every column in Values.
actions.mysql_upsert_row.props.values.de: Column names mapped to values, including the key columns, e.g. {"email": "ada@example.com", "name": "Ada"}.
actions.update_row.description: Updates one or more rows in a table
actions.update_row.props.changes_info.de: Columns you leave out keep their current value.
actions.update_row.props.search_column.d: The column to match rows on.
actions.update_row.props.search_value.de: The value that column must equal.
actions.update_row.props.timezone.descri: Timezone of dates on the server: Z for UTC, or an offset like +02:00.
actions.update_row.props.values.descript: Columns to change and their new values.
auth.props.database.description: The database to use. Only Run Query works without one.
auth.props.host.description: The server's hostname or IP address.
auth.props.port.description: The port the server listens on, usually 3306.
auth.props.user.description: The database user to sign in as.
description: The world's most popular open-source database
